brief: Very long gambrel stock barn about 40 ft wide and 110 ft long, low red walls with a regular row of small white-framed stall windows under a huge weathered brown wood-shingle gambrel roof carrying two metal ventilator cupolas with weathervanes. At mid-length a projecting gambrel-roofed entry bay with white trim and big red double doors is reached by an earthen ramp, so the hayloft can be driven into (bank-barn style). A blue glass-lined storage silo stands at one end and a big weathered grey gable-roofed granary at the other, on a grassy hillside of pasture.
